metadata.description: A bundled Claude Code marketplace of academic-research and scientific-figure skill packages: Light, academic-research-skills, nature-skills, econ-top-journal-writing, writing-ai-paper, auto-visio-helper, visio-image-rebuilder, and frontend-slides.

plugins.name: light
plugins.description: Light — full-pipeline research skill pack (28 skills): literature search, data engineering, idea generation/critique, system & figure design, experiment analysis, paper drafting/polishing, citation, typesetting, peer-review rebuttal, patents/software-copyright, slides and competition materials. Ships 9 traceable knowledge bases and runnable code assets; keep the plugin intact.

plugins.name: academic-research-skills
plugins.description: Production-grade academic research pipeline (4 skills, 35+ modes, multi-agent ensemble): research → write → review → revise → finalize, with deep-research, citation-verification gates, and a Material Passport pipeline.

plugins.name: nature-skills
plugins.description: Nature-style research skills (12): academic search, citation, data, figures, paper-to-patent, paper-to-PPT, polishing, reading/translation, reviewer response, peer review, scientific writing, plus an OpenClaw medical module.

plugins.name: econ-top-journal-writing
plugins.description: Economics top-journal writing workflow (5 skills): workflow router, English economics writing, Chinese top-journal writing, bilingual table/figure design, and a multi-agent writing controller.

plugins.name: writing-ai-paper
plugins.description: Writing AI Conference Papers — the beginner's handbook by hzwer and DingXiaoH, packaged as an invocable skill for planning, drafting, and revising NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR/CVPR-style papers.

plugins.name: auto-visio-helper
plugins.description: Auto Visio Helper (1 skill) — turn method descriptions, paper screenshots, or sketches into editable Microsoft Visio .vsdx diagrams via a spec-first workflow and local Visio COM automation. Ships references, demos, a reusable Visio template, and PNG/PDF/SVG preview export.

plugins.name: visio-image-rebuilder
plugins.description: Visio 图重建 Skill (1 skill: visio-image-rebuilder) — rebuild or restyle editable Microsoft Visio diagrams from reference images and existing .vsdx files, then export .vsdx/PNG/SVG/PDF/PPTX. Recreates paper figures as native shapes/text/connectors instead of embedding a flat image, with panel calibration and a default Chinese technical-bid flowchart mode (SimSun 12pt, fixed page box, VSDX-only batch output). Ships rebuild guidelines and Visio PowerShell/COM automation scaffolds.

plugins.name: frontend-slides
plugins.description: Frontend Slides (1 skill) — zero-dependency, animation-rich HTML presentation generator: build decks from scratch or convert PPT/PPTX to web, with safe presets, a bold template library, a fixed 16:9 stage, and an anti-AI-slop design philosophy.
